"""MIT. Native XML dataset operator; no packages or remote services required."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import signal
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from workspace import Workspace, InputError, load_json
from server import OperatorServer


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Retain XML editions, review explicit mappings, and export original SF30 datasets")
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, help="Private local workspace directory")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("init", help="Create a new private workspace")
    sub.add_parser("list", help="List retained source editions, mappings, builds and comparisons")
    intake = sub.add_parser("source", help="Retain and fully inventory an XML file")
    intake.add_argument("--file", required=True)
    intake.add_argument("--label", default="XML source")
    inspect = sub.add_parser("inspect", help="Inspect the full retained XML shape")
    inspect.add_argument("--source", required=True)
    plan = sub.add_parser("plan", help="Save an immutable explicit mapping")
    plan.add_argument("--file", required=True)
    build = sub.add_parser("build", help="Project every record and validate through the original SF30 engine")
    build.add_argument("--source", required=True); build.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    query = sub.add_parser("query", help="Query a completed build through original native admission/handler")
    query.add_argument("--build", required=True)
    query.add_argument("--params", default="{}", help="JSON object of native scalar-string query parameters")
    compare = sub.add_parser("compare", help="Compare complete keyed editions, retaining all changes")
    compare.add_argument("--before", required=True); compare.add_argument("--after", required=True)
    changes = sub.add_parser("changes", help="Read a page of retained field changes")
    changes.add_argument("--comparison", required=True)
    changes.add_argument("--offset", type=int, default=0); changes.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=50)
    export = sub.add_parser("export", help="Create a portable project ZIP, INCLUDING the original XML")
    export.add_argument("--build", required=True); export.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    publish = sub.add_parser("dataset", help="Export only original CSV/config/lineage to a new directory")
    publish.add_argument("--build", required=True); publish.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    receive = sub.add_parser("import", help="Verify and reconstruct a portable project in this workspace")
    receive.add_argument("--file", required=True)
    serve = sub.add_parser("serve", help="Open the loopback-only industrial operator console")
    serve.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    with Workspace(args.workspace, create=args.command == "init") as ws:
        c = args.command
        if c in {"init", "list"}:
            result = ws.state()
        elif c == "source":
            with Path(args.file).open("rb") as stream:
                result = ws.add_source(stream, args.label, Path(args.file).name)
        elif c == "inspect":
            result = ws.source(args.source)
        elif c == "plan":
            result = ws.save_plan(load_json(Path(args.file).read_bytes()))
        elif c == "build":
            result = ws.build(args.source, args.plan)
        elif c == "query":
            result = ws.query(args.build, load_json(args.params))
        elif c == "compare":
            result = ws.compare(args.before, args.after)
        elif c == "changes":
            result = ws.comparison_page(args.comparison, args.offset, args.limit)
        elif c == "export":
            result = ws.export_packet(args.build, Path(args.out).absolute())
        elif c == "dataset":
            result = ws.export_dataset(args.build, args.out)
        elif c == "import":
            result = ws.import_packet(Path(args.file))
        elif c == "serve":
            if not 0 <= args.port <= 65535:
                raise InputError("Port must be from 0 to 65535")
            server = OperatorServer(ws, args.port)
            print(json.dumps({"console": server.url, "workspace": str(ws.root)}), flush=True)
            def terminate(_signal, _frame):
                raise KeyboardInterrupt
            previous = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, terminate)
            try:
                server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.2)
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                pass
            finally:
                # A second stop must not interrupt draining original HTTP/native work.
                signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
                signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
                try:
                    server.server_close()
                finally:
                    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, previous)
            return
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (InputError, OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(f"XML dataset: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

"""Buyer credit allocations and period projections over original native refund packets."""
from collections import defaultdict
from domain import Problem, amount, day, digest, text, group_amounts

DATA_CONTEXTS = {"operational", "development"}


def data_context(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or value not in DATA_CONTEXTS:
        raise Problem("DATA_CONTEXT", "Choose Operational records or Development operation")
    return value


def allocation_key(line):
    return (line["center_id"], line.get("project", ""), line.get("account_code", ""))


def purchase_matches(item, native):
    if not item or not native:
        return False
    detail = item["row"].get("native_detail") or {}
    return (not item["missing"] and item["row"]["state"] == "settled" and
            item["row"]["network"] == native["network"] and item["row"]["asset"] == native["asset"] and
            item["row"]["settled_base_units"] == native["amount"] and
            detail.get("transfer_identity") == native["transfer_identity"] and
            detail.get("payer") == native["payer"] and detail.get("recipient") == native["recipient"])


def coding_basis(credit, purchase):
    coding = purchase.get("coding") if purchase else None
    return digest({"credit": credit["native_basis"], "purchase_item": credit["item_id"],
                   "purchase_basis": purchase["basis"] if purchase else None,
                   "purchase_coding": {k: coding[k] for k in ("basis", "recognition_date", "allocations")} if coding else None})


def validate_credit_coding(credit, payload, purchase, centers, other_credits):
    if not purchase_matches(purchase, credit["purchase"]):
        raise Problem("CREDIT_PURCHASE_CHANGED", "This refund no longer binds to the retained original buyer payment", 409)
    original = purchase.get("coding")
    if not original or original["basis"] != purchase["basis"]:
        raise Problem("PURCHASE_CODING_REQUIRED", "Review and allocate the original purchase before allocating its return", 409)
    if payload.get("basis") != credit["basis"]:
        raise Problem("CREDIT_CHANGED", "Review the current refund source and original purchase allocation", 409)
    recognition = day(payload.get("recognition_date"))
    if recognition < original["recognition_date"]:
        raise Problem("CREDIT_BEFORE_PURCHASE", "A return allocation cannot precede the recognition date of its original purchase")
    lines = payload.get("allocations")
    if not isinstance(lines, list) or not 1 <= len(lines) <= 100:
        raise Problem("CREDIT_ALLOCATIONS", "Add one to 100 exact return allocation lines")
    available = defaultdict(int)
    for line in original["allocations"]:
        available[allocation_key(line)] += amount(line["amount"])
    used = defaultdict(int)
    total_used = 0
    for other in other_credits:
        if other["id"] == credit["id"] or not other.get("coding"):
            continue
        same_return = other["native"]["transfer_identity"] == credit["native"]["transfer_identity"]
        if same_return:
            raise Problem("RETURN_ALREADY_ALLOCATED", "The same original return event is already allocated by another retained refund", 409)
        if other["item_id"] == credit["item_id"]:
            for line in other["coding"]["allocations"]:
                used[allocation_key(line)] += amount(line["amount"])
                total_used += amount(line["amount"])
    normalized, selected = [], defaultdict(int)
    total = 0
    for line in lines:
        if not isinstance(line, dict):
            raise Problem("CREDIT_ALLOCATIONS", "Each return allocation must be an object")
        center = centers.get(line.get("center_id"))
        if center is None or not center["active"]:
            raise Problem("COST_CENTER_REQUIRED", "Choose an active original cost center")
        record = {"center_id": center["id"], "amount": str(amount(line.get("amount"))),
                  "project": text(line.get("project", ""), "Project", maximum=160, optional=True),
                  "account_code": text(line.get("account_code", ""), "Account code", maximum=120, optional=True),
                  "memo": text(line.get("memo", ""), "Return line memo", maximum=1000, optional=True)}
        key = allocation_key(record)
        if key not in available:
            raise Problem("ORIGINAL_ALLOCATION_REQUIRED", "Use a cost center, project and account combination from the original purchase allocation")
        selected[key] += amount(record["amount"])
        total += amount(record["amount"])
        normalized.append(record)
    expected = amount(credit["native"]["amount"])
    if total != expected:
        raise Problem("CREDIT_ALLOCATION_TOTAL", "Return lines must equal the original verified reverse transfer of " + str(expected) + " base units")
    if total_used + total > amount(credit["purchase"]["amount"]):
        raise Problem("RETURNS_EXCEED_PURCHASE", "These recognized returns exceed the original purchase amount", 409)
    if any(used[key] + value > available[key] for key, value in selected.items()):
        raise Problem("RETURN_ALLOCATION_CAPACITY", "Cumulative returns exceed an original cost-center/project/account allocation; review the other contributing refunds", 409)
    return {"credit_id": credit["id"], "item_id": credit["item_id"], "basis": credit["basis"],
            "recognition_date": recognition, "allocations": normalized,
            "operator": text(payload.get("operator"), "Return allocation owner", maximum=240),
            "memo": text(payload.get("memo", ""), "Return memo", maximum=4000, optional=True)}


def credit_period(view, credits, pending_packets, items, centers, dispositions, closed_credit_lines, data_kind, adjustment_outcomes=None):
    period = view["period"]
    start, through = period["from_day"], period["through_day"]
    by_item = {item["id"]: item for item in items}
    decisions = {(d["item_id"], d["code"]): d for d in dispositions}
    issues, lines, outcomes = [], [], []
    recognized = {}
    for original in closed_credit_lines:
        recognized.setdefault(original["credit_id"], []).append(original)
    def issue(code, credit, description, group=None, allowed=None):
        ident = credit["id"] if credit else ""
        basis = digest({"code": code, "basis": credit["basis"] if credit else None, "group": group})
        selected = decisions.get((ident, code))
        kinds = ["carry_forward", "exclude_from_period"] if allowed is None else allowed
        valid = bool(selected and selected["basis"] == basis and selected["kind"] in kinds)
        issues.append({"code": code, "item_id": ident, "credit_id": ident or None,
                       "request_id": credit["native"]["adjustment_id"] if credit else None,
                       "source_name": credit.get("source_name") if credit else None,
                       "source_capture": credit.get("capture_id") if credit else None,
                       "basis": basis, "description": description, "group": group,
                       "allowed_kinds": kinds, "resolved": valid, "disposition": selected if valid else None})
        return issues[-1]
    for packet in pending_packets:
        issue("REFUND_PACKET_REVIEW_" + packet["id"], None,
              "An original refund packet is awaiting its retained acceptance or rejection",
              {"packet_id": packet["id"], "manifest_sha256": packet["manifest_sha256"]}, [])
    all_returns = {}
    for credit in credits:
        all_returns.setdefault(credit["native"]["transfer_identity"], []).append(credit)
    for credit in credits:
        n, coding, purchase = credit["native"], credit.get("coding"), by_item.get(credit["item_id"])
        native_day = (n.get("transfer_at") or n["observed_at"])[:10]
        if native_day > through and not (coding and start <= coding["recognition_date"] <= through):
            continue
        outcomes.append({"credit_id": credit["id"], "source_name": credit["source_name"],
                         "source_capture": credit["capture_id"], "packet_id": credit["packet_id"],
                         "manifest_sha256": credit["manifest_sha256"], "data_context": credit["data_context"],
                         "item_id": credit["item_id"], "site_url": credit["purchase"].get("site_url"),
                         "source_kind": n.get("source_kind", "woo_refund"),
                         "source_reference": n.get("source_reference"),
                         "present_in_latest_receipt": credit.get("present_in_latest_receipt", True),
                         "latest_source_status": credit.get("latest_source_status"), "latest_source_eligibility": credit.get("latest_source_eligibility"),
                         "order_reference": n.get("order_reference"), "adjustment_id": n["adjustment_id"],
                         "refund_id": n["refund_id"], "merchant_status": n["original_operation_status"],
                         "store_amount": n.get("store_amount"), "currency": n.get("currency"),
                         "store_credit_applied": n["original_operation_status"] == "APPLIED" if n.get("store_amount") is not None else None,
                         "native_return": n["amount"], "network": n["network"], "asset": n["asset"],
                         "transfer_at": n["transfer_at"], "observed_at": n["observed_at"],
                         "transaction": n["transaction"], "original_transaction": n["original_transaction"],
                         "transfer_identity": n["transfer_identity"], "observation_sha256": n["observation_sha256"],
                         "coding_id": coding["id"] if coding else None})
        if purchase is None or not purchase_matches(purchase, credit["purchase"]):
            issue("CREDIT_PURCHASE_CHANGED", credit, "The captured return no longer binds to the current original payment", allowed=[])
            continue
        if not purchase.get("coding") or purchase["coding"]["basis"] != purchase["basis"]:
            issue("CREDIT_PURCHASE_UNCODED", credit, "Allocate the current original purchase before recognizing its return")
            continue
        if coding and coding["recognition_date"] < start:
            if coding["basis"] != credit["basis"]:
                issue("EARLIER_CREDIT_SOURCE_CHANGED", credit, "The source or original purchase allocation changed after earlier return coding; review that original period")
            continue
        if coding and coding["recognition_date"] > through:
            if coding["basis"] != credit["basis"]:
                issue("FUTURE_CREDIT_SOURCE_CHANGED", credit, "The source or original purchase allocation changed after future return coding")
            continue
        if not coding:
            issue("UNCODED_NATIVE_RETURN", credit, "Assign an accounting date and exact original-allocation return, or retain its period disposition")
            continue
        if coding["basis"] != credit["basis"]:
            issue("CREDIT_CODING_CHANGED", credit, "The refund or original purchase allocation changed; review this return allocation")
            continue
        prior = recognized.get(credit["id"])
        if prior:
            issue("RETURN_ALREADY_ISSUED", credit, "This return is recognized in another currently closed period; reopen that original edition before moving it",
                  {"issued_returns": prior}, ["exclude_from_period"])
            continue
        duplicates = [c for c in all_returns[n["transfer_identity"]] if c.get("coding")]
        if len(duplicates) > 1:
            issue("DUPLICATE_NATIVE_RETURN", credit, "The same reverse-transfer event is allocated more than once; correct its original coding",
                  {"credits": sorted(c["id"] for c in duplicates)}, [])
            continue
        for index, line in enumerate(coding["allocations"]):
            center = centers[line["center_id"]]
            lines.append({"credit_id": credit["id"], "item_id": credit["item_id"], "source_id": credit["source_id"],
                          "source_name": credit["source_name"], "source_capture": credit["capture_id"],
                          "packet_id": credit["packet_id"], "manifest_sha256": credit["manifest_sha256"],
                          "adjustment_id": n["adjustment_id"], "refund_id": n["refund_id"],
                          "order_reference": n.get("order_reference"), "source_reference": n.get("source_reference"),
                          "source_kind": n.get("source_kind", "woo_refund"),
                          "present_in_latest_receipt": credit.get("present_in_latest_receipt", True),
                          "network": n["network"], "asset": n["asset"],
                          "original_transaction": n["original_transaction"], "transaction": n["transaction"],
                          "transfer_identity": n["transfer_identity"], "observation_sha256": n["observation_sha256"],
                          "native_return": n["amount"], "recognition_date": coding["recognition_date"],
                          "native_transfer_at": n["transfer_at"], "amount": line["amount"],
                          "center_id": center["id"], "center_code": center["code"], "center_name": center["name"],
                          "project": line["project"], "account_code": line["account_code"],
                          "memo": line["memo"] or coding["memo"], "coding_id": coding["id"], "line": index + 1,
                          "data_context": credit["data_context"]})
    # Current coding heads cannot silently overdraw original dimensions after
    # another purchase allocation is edited or a source edition is adopted.
    aggregate = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    contributors = defaultdict(list)
    for credit in credits:
        if not credit.get("coding"):
            continue
        contributors[credit["item_id"]].append(credit["id"])
        for line in credit["coding"]["allocations"]:
            aggregate[credit["item_id"]][allocation_key(line)] += amount(line["amount"])
    for item_id, used in aggregate.items():
        purchase = by_item.get(item_id)
        if not purchase or not purchase.get("coding"):
            continue
        available = defaultdict(int)
        for line in purchase["coding"]["allocations"]:
            available[allocation_key(line)] += amount(line["amount"])
        if any(total > available[key] for key, total in used.items()):
            for credit in credits:
                if credit["item_id"] == item_id:
                    issue("RETURN_ALLOCATION_CAPACITY", credit,
                          "Cumulative return allocations exceed the current original purchase dimensions",
                          {"credit_ids": sorted(contributors[item_id])}, [])
    gross = view["allocations"]
    returns_as_negative = [line | {"amount": str(-amount(line["amount"]))} for line in lines]
    view["issues"] += issues
    view["unresolved"] = sum(not x["resolved"] for x in view["issues"])
    view["ready"] = view["unresolved"] == 0
    view.update(data_context=data_kind, credit_allocations=lines, credit_totals=group_amounts(lines),
                net_totals=group_amounts(gross + returns_as_negative),
                credit_by_cost_center=group_amounts(lines, ("center_code", "center_name")),
                net_by_cost_center=group_amounts(gross + returns_as_negative, ("center_code", "center_name")),
                merchant_credit_outcomes=outcomes, merchant_adjustment_outcomes=adjustment_outcomes or [])
    view["context_sha256"] = digest({"expense": view["context_sha256"], "data_context": data_kind,
        "credits": [{"id": c["id"], "native_basis": c["native_basis"], "basis": c["basis"],
                     "packet_id": c["packet_id"], "native": c["native"], "coding": c.get("coding")} for c in credits],
        "pending": [{"id": p["id"], "manifest": p["manifest_sha256"]} for p in pending_packets],
        "closed_returns": closed_credit_lines, "adjustment_outcomes": adjustment_outcomes or [],
        "source_presence": [{"id": c["id"], "present": c.get("present_in_latest_receipt", True)} for c in credits]})
    return view

LIMIT = 64 * 1024 * 1024
READER = "stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/merchant-settlement-accounting/accountant/buyer-return-cli.mjs"


def return_bytes(payload):
    raw = payload.get("content_base64")
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or len(raw) > (LIMIT * 4 // 3) + 4:
        raise Problem("ACCOUNTANT_RETURN_SIZE", "Choose an original buyer-return JSON file up to 64 MiB")
    try:
        data = base64.b64decode(raw, validate=True)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise Problem("ACCOUNTANT_RETURN_FILE", "Choose the original complete accountant return") from exc
    if not data or len(data) > LIMIT or base64.b64encode(data).decode() != raw:
        raise Problem("ACCOUNTANT_RETURN_FILE", "Choose the original complete accountant return")
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != payload.get("sha256"):
        raise Problem("ACCOUNTANT_RETURN_CHANGED", "The returned file differs from the reviewed SHA-256", 409)
    return data


def inspect_return(source_bytes, packet_bytes, node=None):
    reader = source_root() / READER
    if reader.is_symlink() or not reader.is_file():
        raise Problem("ACCOUNTANT_READER_MISSING", "Use the original installed buyer accountant-return reader", 409)
    request = {"buyerSourceBase64": base64.b64encode(source_bytes).decode(),
               "packetBase64": base64.b64encode(packet_bytes).decode()}
    result = subprocess.run([node_path(node), str(reader)], input=json.dumps(request, separators=(",", ":")).encode(),
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120, check=False)
    if result.returncode:
        try:
            error = json.loads(result.stderr).get("error", {})
        except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
            error = {}
        raise Problem(error.get("code", "ACCOUNTANT_RETURN_REJECTED"),
                      error.get("message", "The original accountant engine rejected this returned packet"),
                      error.get("status", 422))
    try:
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        if (value["schema"] != "stellar-forge.buyer-accountant-return-inspection.v1"
                or value["source"]["sha256"] != hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest()
                or value["packetSha256"] != hashlib.sha256(packet_bytes).hexdigest()
                or not isinstance(value["rows"], list) or not isinstance(value["revisions"], list)):
            raise ValueError()
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise Problem("ACCOUNTANT_RETURN_FORMAT", "The native reader did not return the complete original source identity", 422) from exc
    return value

def capture_adjustments(source_file, source_sha256, event_id, expected_job=None, node=None):
    source = Path(source_file).expanduser()
    if not source.is_absolute() or source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file():
        raise Problem("ADJUSTMENT_FILE", "Choose the absolute original accounting-export JSON file")
    if not isinstance(source_sha256, str) or not HEX.fullmatch(source_sha256):
        raise Problem("ADJUSTMENT_SOURCE_HASH", "Use the exact original export SHA-256")
    if not isinstance(event_id, str) or not HEX.fullmatch(event_id):
        raise Problem("ADJUSTMENT_EVENT", "Select the original accounting event ID")
    if expected_job is not None and not isinstance(expected_job, dict):
        raise Problem("ADJUSTMENT_JOB_BINDING", "Use the original job ID and settlement selection")
    reader = source_root() / READER
    if reader.is_symlink() or not reader.is_file():
        raise Problem("ADJUSTMENT_READER_MISSING", "Use the original installed merchant adjustment reader", 409)
    args = [node_path(node), str(reader), "--source-file", str(source), "--source-sha256", source_sha256, "--event-id", event_id]
    if expected_job is not None:
        args += ["--expected-job", json.dumps(expected_job, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)]
    result = subprocess.run(args, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120, check=False)
    if result.returncode:
        raise Problem("ADJUSTMENT_SOURCE_REJECTED",
                      result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[-3000:] or "The original adjustment reader rejected the selected receipt", 422)
    try:
        native = json.loads(result.stdout)

                or native["source_sha256"] != source_sha256 or native["source_identity"]["event_id"] != event_id
                or not isinstance(native["credits"], list) or not isinstance(native["adjustments"], list)
                or not HEX.fullmatch(native["manifest_sha256"])):

        purchase = native["purchase"]
        if purchase is not None:

                raise ValueError()

def quote_rows(snapshot):

        raise ValueError("The original MCP reader did not return a complete source capture.")
    if snapshot.get("quoteCount") != len(snapshot["records"]):
        raise ValueError("The source's complete quote count does not match its retained records.")
    rows, seen = [], set()
    for record in snapshot["records"]:
        q, payment = record["quote"], record["payment"]
        ident = q["quoteId"]
        if ident in seen:
            raise ValueError("The original quote source contains a repeated identity.")
        seen.add(ident)
        accepted = q["accepted"]
        amount = accepted.get("amount")
        exact = amount if isinstance(amount, str) and INTEGER.fullmatch(amount) else None
        observed = payment.get("observation")
        receipt = (q.get("result") or {}).get("paymentResponse")
        content = (q.get("result") or {}).get("content") or {}
        response = (q.get("result") or {}).get("responseFile")
        invocation = q.get("invocation") or {}
        classification = payment["classification"]
        state = {"TRANSFER_MATCHED":"settled", "FAILED_TRANSACTION":"failed",
                 "NO_SIGNED_DISPATCH":"not_dispatched", "UNRESOLVED":"unresolved",
                 "OBSERVATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED":"observation_review"}[classification]
        if state == "settled" and exact is None:
            raise ValueError("The saved matched transfer lost its original exact amount.")
        transaction = observed.get("transaction") if isinstance(observed, dict) else None
        if transaction is None and isinstance(receipt, dict):
            transaction = receipt.get("transaction")
        if not isinstance(transaction, str) or not HEX.fullmatch(transaction.lower()):
            transaction = None
        else:
            transaction = transaction.lower()
        payer = observed.get("payer") if isinstance(observed, dict) else None
        if not payer and isinstance(receipt, dict):
            payer = receipt.get("payer")
        detail = {"quote_id":ident, "quote_sha256":record["quoteSha256"],
                  "classification":classification, "native_status":q["status"], "phase":q.get("phase"),
                  "created_at_ms":q["createdAt"], "updated_at_ms":q["updatedAt"],
                  "signed_request_dispatched":q["signedRequestDispatched"], "attempts":q["attempts"],
                  "url":q["url"], "method":q["method"], "tool_name":invocation.get("toolName"),
                  "arguments_sha256":invocation.get("argumentsSha256"),
                  "payer":payer, "recipient":accepted.get("payTo"), "quoted_amount":exact,
                  "transaction":transaction, "receipt":receipt, "observation":observed,
                  "observation_sha256":payment.get("observationSha256"),
                  "transfer_identity":payment.get("transferIdentity"), "problems":payment.get("problems", []),
                  "result_file":response,
                  "result_preview":{key:content[key] for key in ("contentType","bodyBytes","bodySha256","omitted","truncated") if key in content},
                  "superseded_observation":(q.get("result") or {}).get("supersededReconciliation")}
        # Ignore checkpoint time alone; semantic quote/result/payment changes
        # require an explicit source/coding review in the existing workspace.
        context = dict(detail)
        context.pop("updated_at_ms", None)
        context.pop("quote_sha256", None)
        row = {"request_id":ident, "request_digest":record["identitySha256"],
               "actor":payer or q["operatorScope"], "service":invocation.get("toolName") or q["resource"],
               "network":accepted.get("network", ""), "asset":accepted.get("asset", ""),
               "scheme":accepted.get("scheme", ""), "amount":exact or "", "day":
                   datetime.fromtimestamp(q["createdAt"] / 1000, timezone.utc).date().isoformat(),
               "state":state, "actual":exact if state == "settled" else "",
               "receipt_ref":accepted.get("network", "") + "/" + transaction if transaction else "",
               "proof_sha256":payment.get("observationSha256") if state == "settled" else "",
               "settled_base_units":exact if state == "settled" else None,
               "reserved_base_units":"0", "released_capacity_base_units":"0", "age_utc_days":None,
               "source_kind":"mcp_quote", "native_date_basis":"MCP quote creation day",
               "native_context_sha256":digest(context), "native_detail":detail}
        rows.append(row)
    return sorted(rows, key=lambda row:(row["day"], row["request_id"]))


def project_snapshot(snapshot):
    rows = quote_rows(snapshot)
    groups = {}
    for row in rows:
        key = (row["network"], row["asset"])
        group = groups.setdefault(key, {"network":key[0], "asset":key[1], "requests":0,
            "pending_requests":0, "unresolved_quotes":0, "settled_base_units":0,
            "reserved_base_units":"0", "released_capacity_base_units":"0"})
        group["requests"] += 1
        if row["state"] == "settled":
            group["settled_base_units"] += int(row["settled_base_units"])
        elif row["state"] in ("unresolved", "observation_review"):
            group["unresolved_quotes"] += 1
    for group in groups.values():
        group["accounted_base_units"] = str(group["settled_base_units"])
        group["settled_base_units"] = str(group["settled_base_units"])
    return {"schema":"stellar-forge.mcp-expense-statement.v1", "captured_at":snapshot["capturedAt"],
            "source":{"kind":"mcp_quote", "database_name":"quotes.sqlite",
                      "records":len(rows), "record_kind":"quotes", "journal_events":snapshot["transitionCount"],
                      "last_sequence":snapshot["lastSequence"], "projection_sha256":digest(rows),
                      "quote_projection_sha256":snapshot["quoteProjectionSha256"], "quote_bytes":snapshot["quoteBytes"]},
            "rows":rows, "portfolio":[groups[k] for k in sorted(groups)],
            "basis":"Original MCP quote snapshot and its retained, exact-bound SF86 payment observations",
            "date_basis":"Original quote creation day; payment and operator recognition dates remain separate",
            "notes":["Seller-reported success alone is unresolved payment, not allocated expense.",
                     "Only a saved original SF86 TRANSFER_MATCHED observation enters settled expense.",
                     "No MCP quote amount becomes an SF36 reservation or released spending capacity.",
                     "Result metadata is retained as recorded; purchased result bytes remain in the original buyer workspace."]}


def capture_mcp_quotes(path, node=None):
    selected = Path(path).expanduser()
    if not selected.is_absolute() or selected.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Choose the absolute original private MCP quote directory, without a directory symlink.")
    command = [node_path(node), str(reader_path()), "--state-dir", str(selected)]
    completed = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                               stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60, check=False)
    if len(completed.stdout) > MAX_OUTPUT or len(completed.stderr) > 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("The original source exceeded the complete native capture capacity.")
    if completed.returncode:
        message = "The original MCP quote reader could not capture this source."
        try:
            error = json.loads(completed.stderr.decode().splitlines()[-1]).get("error", {})
            message = str(error.get("code", "MCP_CAPTURE_FAILED")) + ": " + str(error.get("message", message))
        except (ValueError, IndexError, UnicodeError):
            pass
        raise ValueError(message)
    snapshot = json.loads(completed.stdout)
    return {"path":snapshot["directory"], "identity":snapshot["identity"],
            "snapshot":snapshot, "report":project_snapshot(snapshot)}
